preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.
The number of friends N for each test case must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(len(time) == 8 and time[2] == ':' and time[5] in 'AMPM' for time in [P] + [L_i for L_i, R_i in friends] + [R_i for L_i, R_i in friends])
preconditions.description: All times must be in the format 'HH:MM AM' or 'HH:MM PM' with valid two-digit hours and minutes.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == N and all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must have length N and consist only of '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i] == '1') == (L_i <= P <= R_i) for i, (L_i, R_i) in enumerate(friends))
postconditions.description: For each friend, the output character must be '1' if the meeting time P is within their availability range, otherwise '0'.
